full_prompt_en: A square graphic action portrait sets a dark-skinned samurai figure against a huge flat red circular disk on an off-white paper ground. The figure is centered and shown from about the waist upward. An enormous black afro spreads across the upper portion like a rough cloud, nearly merging with the black splashes around it. The narrow face remains mostly in shadow, with small bright eyes, a stern closed mouth, and large thin hoop earrings catching light on either side. A loose black outer robe opens into a bold white V around the chest, exposing a gray angular torso rendered with blocky tonal planes. One long vertical red strip falls on the right side of the body. Near the lower half, red-and-black wrapped sword handles cross diagonally in front of the dark robe; their geometry cuts through rough black paint and red splatter. The red disk is worn by scratches, pale streaks, and broken edges, and it stops short of the square's sides. Off-white paper remains visible beyond it, bearing scuffs and faint grain. A narrow vertical column of red characters sits at the lower left; it is decorative and too small to read reliably. The composition is boldly symmetrical around head and disk but broken by diagonal swords and irregular ink bursts. Red, black, white, and a little gray form nearly the entire palette. Flat posterlike areas alternate with scratchy dry-brush edges, chipped marks, and layered paint. Light does not describe a realistic room; it selectively reveals facial planes and the robe's white opening. The image is still, severe, and confrontational, with the oversized hair silhouette and circular red field carrying most of its force.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形化动作肖像把深肤色武士放在巨大平面红圆盘前，底子是米白纸面。人物居中，画到腰部左右。极大的黑色爆炸头如粗糙云朵铺满上部，几乎与四周黑墨溅痕相合。狭长面孔多在阴影里，只有细小亮眼、紧闭的严厉嘴巴和两侧接光的细大圈耳环。宽松黑外袍在胸前打开为醒目的白色 V，露出由棱角调子块表现的灰色躯干。身体右侧垂下一根长红带。下半部，红黑缠柄的剑柄在深袍前斜向交叉，几何形状切过粗黑颜料与红色飞溅。红圆盘表面被刮痕、浅色条纹与破损边缘磨旧，并未延伸到方画四边。盘外露着带擦痕与淡颗粒的米白纸面。左下有一列窄小红字，起装饰作用，太小而无法可靠辨认。头与圆盘周围的构图大胆对称，却被斜剑和不规则墨痕打破。红、黑、白与少量灰几乎构成全部色盘。平面海报色域与粗糙干笔边缘、崩裂记号和叠层颜料交替。光不描绘真实房间，只选择性显出面部平面和袍的白色开口。画面静止、严酷且直面观者，过大的头发剪影和圆形红场承担主要力量。
style_prompt_en: A stark graphic poster language reduces the palette to vermilion red, ink black, warm off-white, and restrained gray. A large imperfect disk anchors the background, while an oversized ragged silhouette crowds its upper edge. Hard flat color blocks meet scratchy dry-brush borders, splashes, scuffs, and chipped paper texture. A bright V-shaped opening and a few small highlights cut through the dominant dark mass. Diagonal banded elements cross the lower field and disrupt the otherwise frontal, centered arrangement. Realistic depth is deliberately limited; impact comes from scale, silhouette, sharp value contrast, and rough printlike wear. Narrow vertical graphic marks can appear as secondary decoration, never competing with the central form. The mood is fierce, spare, and iconic.
style_prompt_zh: 严厉的图形海报语言把色盘压缩为朱红、墨黑、暖米白与克制灰色。一枚不完美的大圆盘固定背景，过大的毛边剪影挤住它的上缘。坚硬平面色块碰上粗糙干笔边界、飞溅、擦痕和破损纸纹。明亮 V 形开口与少量小高光切入主导暗团块。下方带状斜线穿过画域，扰动正面居中的总体安排。真实空间深度被有意减弱；冲击力来自尺度、剪影、强明暗对比与粗旧印刷感。窄竖向图形记号可作次要装饰，不与中央形体竞争。气氛凶猛、简练而具标志性。
theme_en: An afro-haired samurai figure stands before a weathered red disk with crossed sword handles
theme_zh: 爆炸头武士立于磨旧红圆盘前，交错剑柄横穿下方
name: Afro Samurai
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
